lesson_title: A Thousand Ropes Over a Hole
hook_text: This old photograph shows a hole so busy it looks like a giant spider web.
clip_script: Kimberley, 1870s. A black-and-white photograph shows a huge pit full of tiny squares, and hundreds of ropes and wires stretched across it. People are digging for diamonds. Look closer: carts, buckets, men with spades. Today the same place is the Big Hole, quiet and full of green water. Pictures are sources. Ask what you see, who, where, when and why. Then compare then and now.
visual_style: Whiteboard sketch of the old diggings with crossing ropes, slowly changing into the Big Hole with water, then a magnifying glass moving over details.
mood: Like a detective solving a mystery with a magnifying glass.
pacing: Show the old picture, zoom in on clues, then flip to the picture of today.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find an old photograph of your area to compare with today.
